_note: Deployment PROFILES. Mycelium is sized for a whole lab — 26k lines, 56 tables, 285 endpoints, 16 plugins — and most embeddings need a fraction of that. A profile declares which route domains and plugins load; everything else is never mounted, so a slim deployment pays neither the boot cost nor the API surface. Domains not listed are ABSENT, not disabled: no routes, no handlers, no reachable endpoints. Set MYCELIUM_PROFILE=<name>; default 'full' preserves today's behaviour exactly.

full.description: Everything. The lab substrate — the default, and what jetson01 runs.

maintainer.description: Repo-maintainer: coordination, memory, team conventions, trust.

_pillars.coordination: tasks + messages — what is queued, who is on it, what came back
_pillars.memory: context — facts, cards, the reference graph, keyed by repo+sha
_pillars.conventions: context namespace `conventions/<repo>` — the repo's own rules, partly derived from the parse, partly stated by the team. NOT YET MODELLED: a convention is a claim about the repo that can be grounded or violated, and a violation is a finding.
_pillars.trust: context namespace `trust/<repo>` — card trust levels, quarantine reasons, and the human verdict. Currently dies with the process, which is why the review queue cannot persist.

edge.description: Field node — Pi/Jetson class. Presence, messages and context only; nothing that assumes a workstation.
edge._why: A field node reports in, receives work, and carries local state. Everything else is coordination it does not perform.

squad.description: Agent coordination without the product surfaces — what the local crew actually touches.

_measured: 2026-08-03: full = 15 route domains + 16 plugin dirs. maintainer = 3 domains + 2 plugins. The point is not lines of code — it is that an embedded deployment should not expose 285 endpoints to reach a card store.
_frame: Mycelium is a LAYER — local memory + coordination for anything that can make an HTTP request. Profiles exist so attaching it costs a small, legible surface instead of a platform. A thing that needs a card store should not inherit drones, billing and channels to get one.
